description: Create a new non-custodial multi-chain USDT/USDC payment invoice and hosted checkout page on Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, or Solana settling 100% directly to `merchant_wallet` with 0% platform custody. State-changing operation creating a single-use `pending` invoice record (unlimited free calls, no authentication required). Supports recurring SaaS subscriptions via optional `customer_ref` and `billing_days`. Returns JSON with `ok` (boolean), `checkout_url` (hosted payment page), and `invoice` (`invoice_id`, `status`, `amount_usd`, `network`, `merchant_wallet`, `expires_at`).

amount_usd.description: Exact invoice price denominated in USD (settled 1:1 in USDT or USDC on-chain, e.g. `19.0`). Must be >= `0.01`.

billing_days.description: Optional subscription duration in days (e.g. `30` for monthly, `365` for annual). Pass `0` for one-time purchases.

customer_ref.description: Optional external customer identifier (e.g. email, user ID, or Telegram ID) for tracking recurring subscription status.

merchant_wallet.description: Merchant's self-custody receiving wallet address (`0x...` for EVM chains or base58 public key for `solana`). Funds transfer directly here.

network.description: Settlement blockchain network (`polygon`, `bsc`, `base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, `solana`, or `bitcoin`). Defaults to `polygon`.

title.description: Human-readable product, order, or subscription plan title displayed on the hosted checkout page (2-140 chars).

ttl_minutes.description: Invoice expiration window in minutes (`5` to `43200`). After `ttl_minutes`, unpaid invoices cannot be settled. Defaults to `60`.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to receive an HMAC-SHA256 signed `invoice.paid` POST webhook upon on-chain settlement.

name: create_usdt_invoice
